utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can bring some tools and spare batteries. If you want, I can also grab a box or bag to keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Bo — I’m just collecting the repair-drive list, and I’ll repeat it to the neighbors once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking, Faye — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. If you can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I can help spread the word, and Sunday at the community center should be easy to share around the school run.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep coordinating the list, and if you hear any questions, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday at 10 works for me too—thanks, Sam. I’ll send over the repair list soon and start gathering tools, tape, screws, and any spare paint I can find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren — I can check the first few homes and note anything urgent. Send the list when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Sam — I’ll get that list together and send it over soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, it’s going well — I’m still collecting the repair-drive list and I’ll pass it along once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — thanks, Jules. Keep me posted when the list’s ready and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — I will. I’m finishing the list now and I’ll send it over as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still putting the list together, but I should have an update soon. And yes, I may take you up on that extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Mara—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira—that’d be really helpful. I’ll send the update as soon as I’ve got the list nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Count me in, Leo — I’ll tell a few more neighbors too. Just let me know what supplies or hands you still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn. Just need a few more hands to sort the donated items and stack them by size.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll spread the word and see who can come help sort and stack. Just point me to the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for checking in. I’m still sorting the list, but a few homes need small fixes and I can use help organizing the first round.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help organize the first round. Just let me know what you want me to start with.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any updates right away. If I hear a better time for drop-offs, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ll do the same and pass along anything I hear. I’m still waiting on the location, so if you hear it first, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep my ear to the ground for the location and send it your way as soon as I hear. Sounds like the repair drive is really coming together nicely!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you heard who’s coordinating the repairs yet, and when do folks need to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t heard the coordinator confirmed yet, but I’m checking around. I’ll let you know the drop-off time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — please keep me posted when you find out. I’m especially trying to pin down the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard anything new yet, Hana, but I’ll check around while I’m out and let you know if I do.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — please let me know if you hear about any specific repairs or tools we should bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Hana — I’ll ask around and keep an eye out for any specific repairs or tools we should bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring whatever tools, tape, screws, or spare paint I can find to the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep sorting supplies at the shed, and we’ll put everything to good use.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Glad to help — I’ll swing by the shed soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t heard the location for the repair drive yet, but I’m keeping an eye out. I’ll let you know as soon as I spot where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening, right? Let me know the location as soon as you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s still happening — I just don’t have the location yet. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear where it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey — I’m still collecting the repair-drive list, and once it’s set I’ll repeat it to a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works — I can help keep the list simple if you want. Just let me know when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring some tools and a box for the extras—what should I tell folks to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m glad you’re organizing it, Bo — I can help with the list too. Tell folks to bring any broken small appliances or furniture that needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll tell folks to bring broken small appliances or furniture, and I’ll bring tools and a box for the extras.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — yes, it’s still on. I’m still putting the list together and I’ll share the update as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — just keep me posted if the timing or the list changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Saturday morning works for me. I just need to know where to bring everything and whether you want it labeled by owner.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t heard the repair drive location yet, but I’m keeping an eye out and will let you know as soon as I spot it. Labeling by owner would be helpful if you can do that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll label everything by owner and keep an eye out for the location too. Once you hear where it’s going, just let me know and I’ll bring it Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’m happy to check around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Ira—thank you. Just let me know if you hear anything urgent about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know right away if I hear anything urgent about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — we’re still collecting tools, tape, screws, and any spare paint you can spare. Just drop anything handy by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll let folks know to bring supplies to the community shed, and I’ll keep the Sunday repair drive at the community center organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Rosa — thank you for keeping it organized. I’ll keep tracking supplies, and we’ll be ready for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday at 10 still works for me—can you send the repair list when it’s ready, and I’ll keep track of the details?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair list as soon as it’s ready and keep you posted on any updates. Thanks for helping keep track of everything!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll watch for the list and stay on top of the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the location for the repair drive, but I’m keeping an eye out. I’ll let you know as soon as I spot where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate you keeping watch. I’ll let folks know as soon as we pin down the spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep listening and pass it along as soon as I hear where it’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, the repair drive is coming together nicely — I’m just helping gather the list and spread the word. Let me know if you want me to pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules — please let me know the final list when it’s set. I like having a clear plan, and I’ll keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Eli — I’ll send you the final list as soon as it’s set and keep you posted on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know the best window as soon as I hear it. If anything changes with the repair drive, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess. Appreciate you keeping me posted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet, Leo — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the best time to stop by. Hopefully it stays nice and busy for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 works for me—I can plan around school drop-off and pickup. Just send the location when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks, Faye — I’ll send the location over as soon as I dig it up. Saturday at 10 sounds great.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once you have the location, send it my way and I’ll plan around school.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still putting the list together, but I should have an update soon. And yes, I may take you up on that extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay — just let me know what you need, and I’ll help when the list is ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina — I appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as the list is ready.
